title: Fibrinolytic Therapy Versus Medical Thoracoscopy
brief_summary: The purpose of this prospective randomized clinical trial is to compare two currently accepted standard-of-care treatment strategies: medical thoracoscopy as compared to instillation of intrapleural tissue plasminogen activator (TPA) and human recombinant deoxyribonuclease (DNase) for the management of complicated pleural infections in adults as defined as complicated parapneumonic effusions or pleural empyema.
